title: SHEIN size guide: which size to order and how to read each size chart
seoTitle: SHEIN size guide: which size to order and how to read it
description: At SHEIN the same letter changes from brand to brand: two M tees differ by 11 cm at the bust. Choose by the measurements of each piece in cm, not by your usual letter.
metaDescription: Size at SHEIN: the letter changes by brand. The 4CW5Y does give you a discount on a SHEIN selection. Measure in cm and read each piece's size guide.
imageAlt: Front view of a model wearing a black SHEIN Essnce T-shirt and jeans in an official photo, with the SHEIN logo, S, M and L letters and cm unit.

cta.label: Go to SHEIN
cta.text: Open the guide and identify whether the chart is for the body or the garment. Compare like references before choosing a size.

contentSections.heading: Quick answer
paragraphs: At SHEIN, open the specific item's guide and compare its body chart with your measurements; for product measurements, consider garment dimensions and the fit you want. Your usual letter is not enough. Return options and costs depend on the policy and the item.

contentSections.heading: The same letter changes from brand to brand
paragraphs: You wear M, you order M, and the T-shirt arrives in a different size: at SHEIN, the letter is no yardstick. The platform sells different brands, and each brand measures its M its own way. Two plain short-sleeve tees show the size of the problem.

comparisonTable.caption: Bust of the piece in international size M, from each page's size guide; the full DAZY guide is further down.
headers: Bust of the piece in M

postParagraphs: Our math: from the piece measurements in both guides, the DAZY M has 11 cm more bust than the Essnce M, almost the bust of the Essnce XL. The store says: the DAZY page itself warns that the brand follows Asian sizing and runs smaller than SHEIN.

What this changes when you buy: each piece has its own guide, and that guide is the one that counts. The way not to go wrong is to ignore the letter, open the piece's size guide and compare centimeter by centimeter. The next two sections show how: first your body, then the guide.

contentSections.heading: How to measure your body
paragraphs: Before opening any guide, you need three of your numbers: bust, waist and hips. Rule of thumb: use a sewing tape over light clothing, with the tape touching the skin without pulling. Where to pass the tape for each measurement:
bullets: Bust: at the fullest part, with the tape level, passing under the arms and across the back at the same height.
Waist: at the narrowest point of the torso, usually a little above the navel, breathing normally.
Hips: at the widest part of the hips, with feet together.
postParagraphs: Record your measurements in centimeters and follow the guide's method. Check all relevant areas for the garment, not only bust or waist. If measurements point to different sizes, compare cut and charts; do not simply choose the larger number assuming alterations will be easy.

contentSections.heading: How to read the piece's guide: piece measurement, body measurement and ease
paragraphs: What decides the size is knowing which table you are looking at, because the SHEIN guide can have two. The product measurements table is the garment measured flat: the DAZY T-shirt's bust in M is the garment's measurement, not your body's. The body measurements table, when the piece has one, is the body range the brand gives for each letter, and its own note says it is for reference only. Some pieces only have the garment table, like the Essnce; then the comparison is direct, between your measurement and the piece's, and the ease is up to you.

comparisonTable.caption: Size guide for the DAZY T-shirt, as of November 4, 2026, in centimeters: product measurements on the left (bust and length; shoulder and sleeve left out), body range on the right.

postParagraphs: In the DAZY example, M measures 93 cm while its body chart lists 82–86 cm: a difference of 7–11 cm. In Essnce, the model with an 87 cm bust wears an S that measures 78 cm. These are two product examples, not a formula for every fabric with or without elastane. Stretch does not replace considering ease and the fit you want.

The guide warns that piece measurements can vary by 1 to 2 cm, and the descriptions of both T-shirts mention changes after washing at home. Between sizes, check the body chart, the piece measurements, the cut and the stretch together. Stretch alone is not a reason to size up or to pick a piece smaller than your body measurements. If the information is insufficient, check that item's guidance before ordering.

contentSections.heading: What else the page shows: the model and the buyers
paragraphs: Use buyer reports as supporting information: look for measurements and fit comments without automatically copying someone else's size. The DAZY page shows 93% true to size, 6% small and 1% large; the Essnce page shows 95% true to size. These shares come from the people who rated each item. A high "small" share is a reason to reread the guide and reports, not an automatic instruction to size up.

The model is a height reference. On the DAZY, she is 176 cm tall with an 87 cm bust and wears the international M; on the Essnce, 175 cm and an 87 cm bust, in S. Same bust, different letters, in both brands: it's the letter problem again. The size and fit details button shows the model's measurements on the page itself.

Below the sizes, some pages have a size-finder link that suggests a size. SHEIN's help page says the tool asks for height, age and weight to suggest a letter. When you are logged in, the suggestion appears on its own for some pieces. Use it as a second opinion, never in place of the tape: it does not ask for your bust or your waist, and that is exactly where the letter changes.

contentSections.heading: If it doesn't fit: returns
paragraphs: If a garment does not fit, a return and possible new order can take time and money. It is not a guaranteed sequence of two deliveries. Check eligibility and policy before relying on that option.
The return policy for your country is in SHEIN's help center. Returns and the store's reputation are covered in [Is SHEIN trustworthy?](/en/reviews/is-shein-legit-and-safe).

contentSections.heading: Before you buy
paragraphs: The size is settled before the cart, in this order:
bullets: Measure bust, waist and hips and write them down in centimeters.
Open the piece's size guide and keep it on CM.
Check whether the table is for the piece or for the body. Compare it with your measurement and count the ease.
Read cut and stretch alongside the charts; "stretchy" is not a rule for choosing a piece equal to or smaller than your body.
Check the buyers' fit rating and look in their table for someone with your measurements.
Check the tolerance in the specific item's guide: the 1–2 cm variation and the changes after washing were described for these two T-shirts and do not apply automatically to every item.
Keep the order confirmation and the tracking number: a return depends on them, if the piece doesn't fit.
postParagraphs: Delivery time, shipping and what to check before paying are in [Is SHEIN worth it?](/en/reviews/is-shein-worth-it). The 4CW5Y is SHEIN's referral code and it does give you a discount: open SHEIN through Cecília's link and search 4CW5Y in the app or on the site: the code opens a page of recommended products, promotions and discounts. SHEIN decides how much and on which pieces; current promotions are on the [SHEIN page](/en/coupons/shein).

contentSections.heading: Which size to order: a summary by situation
bullets: Fabric without elastane, with no or slight stretch (the DAZY T-shirt): compare the body chart and the piece measurements with the fit you want; a boundary alone does not mean sizing up.

Fabric with elastane, medium or high stretch, and only the piece measurement in the guide (the Essnce): consider the cut, the fit and the comfort you expect. The model's S is an example of that product, not a rule for every body.
A brand the page warns runs smaller (the DAZY): read the brand's own body table, not your usual letter.

Between sizes, use the charts, cut and buyer reports for that same item together. If information is insufficient, check measurements or choose another piece; do not automatically copy another buyer's size.
contentSections.emphasis: Choose your SHEIN size using the measurements in each item's size guide. The same size label can fit differently across brands.

contentSections.heading: Frequently asked questions
bullets: What is my size at SHEIN? Whatever the piece's size guide gives for your measurement in centimeters; the letter changes from brand to brand, as the two T-shirts in the first section show.

Are SHEIN sizes small? You can't answer by the letter: each piece's page shows the fit type, the stretch and the percentage of buyers who found it true to size, and for the two T-shirts in this guide most found it true to size; the numbers are in the section “What else the page shows”.
Does SHEIN exchange for another size? It depends on the country: the return and exchange policy for each one is in SHEIN's help center.
How do I measure my bust for SHEIN? With the tape at the fullest part of the bust, level across the back and not pulling; the section on how to measure also covers the waist and hips.

takeIf: The piece measurement in the guide, in centimeters, gives the ease you want, and the fit type and the stretch match what you expect from the fabric.
The buyer reports on the page include people with measurements close to yours, and you read them as support: the size they ordered does not guarantee your fit.
skipIf: You chose by your usual letter without opening the piece's guide: the same letter changes from brand to brand.
You need the piece for a fixed date, with no time to try it on, return it or find an alternative; a sizing error may require another order.
